_comment: This base file holds structure and non-secret defaults only. Environment-specific URLs live in appsettings.{UAT|PROD}.json and are selected via Icegate:Environment / ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT - these are SHARED across every onboarded client. Each client's own credentials/identifiers/internal API key go in IcegateClients (one entry per client, added at onboarding - see docs/Multi_Client_Onboarding.md). Never place real secrets (IcegateClients[].ApiKey, IcegateClients[].EncryptedCredentialData, connection strings with credentials) in source control - use User Secrets, environment variables, or a secret manager.
_icegateClientsComment: IcegateClients is an array, one entry per onboarded client, each with its OWN ICEGATE identity and its OWN internal API key. Leave empty here; populate real entries only via secret storage / environment variables, never committed with real values. Shape: [{ 'ClientId': '...', 'ApiKey': '...', 'EncryptedCredentialData': '...', 'IcegateApiKey': '...', 'DefaultSenderId': '...', 'DefaultIcegateId': '...', 'DefaultCustodianCode': '...', 'Enabled': true }]
